description: This file defines the `CurlHandler` class, which is an HTTP handler that uses cURL easy handles as a transport layer within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It manages cURL handle creation, optional delay before execution, and returns a promise for the request execution.

classes.name: CurlHandler
classes.description: An HTTP handler that utilizes cURL easy handles for network requests, supporting configurable options and promise-based asynchronous execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a CurlHandler with optional configuration, primarily setting up the cURL handle factory.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request using cURL, optionally delays execution, and returns a promise representing the asynchronous operation.
